Attack Vector: Unknown automatic infection, accidental infection, no targeted attack
Indicators of Compromise: Ransomware message: 'You Hacked, ALL Data Encrypted. Contact For Key(cryptom27@yandex.com)ID:681 ,Enter.'
Twitter posts with infected computer screenshots
Backdoors and vulnerabilities in SFMTA systems
